messages.text: Manufacturing engineering needs one defensible decision for released service bulletin by 2026-01-15; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside bulletin number, revision, release, model, serial, and work order must match.
I found 3 FILES on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0069 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000069 up to 1 FILES, provided bulletin number, revision, release, model, serial, and work order must match. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or delay_for_future_revision.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for repair-work start date is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R8 and the CASE-070 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-069.

Required closeout records: append one dated decision row to the existing audit tab; do not overwrite prior entries; and add the resulting Oracle reference, option, date, and constraint as a comment on the existing case file. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
